NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 构建从芯片到软件全栈加速计算平台，为数据中心和AI模型提供端到端基础设施。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Full-stack accelerated computing platform for data center-scale AI, from chips to software and services.

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 微软将人工智能全面融入产品线，构建智能云与智能边缘平台，引领AI平台浪潮并确保安全可靠。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate AI across the full stack, lead the platform wave, and deliver responsible, secure transformation.
concrete_bets: Intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AIP平台为核心，将生成式AI与企业数据操作深度融合，赋能商业与政府决策。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Deploy AIP to integrate generative AI with enterprise data operations, enabling AI-driven decisions across commercial and government sectors.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 将AI融入产品与服务，打造跨应用AI助手和智能穿戴，推动沉浸式体验。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate AI across apps, wearables, and ranking systems to build immersive social experiences.
concrete_bets: Meta AI assistant across apps and devices
AI-powered content ranking and discovery engine
Ray-Ban and Oakley Meta AI glasses

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 关注新模型发布、缩放定律、推理控制、长上下文与效率优化等模型层进展。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers new model releases, scaling laws, reasoning effort, long-context efficiency, and performance frontiers.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及智能体构建、编码助手、企业部署、健康与日常应用。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Encompasses agent building, coding assistants, enterprise deployments, and health/everyday applications.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 聚焦AI安全事件、安全评估、代码安全、治理与滥用防范。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Focuses on AI safety incidents, security evals, code security, governance, and abuse prevention.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖数学、理论CS、自改进、量子、创造力、科学框架等学术研究。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers mathematics, theoretical CS, self-improvement, quantum, creativity, and scientific frameworks.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 包括库发布、GPU管理、地理空间推理、模拟、数据采集、硬件优化、展示会等。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Includes library releases, GPU management, geospatial inference, simulation, data capture, hardware optimization, showcases.
